title: Boundary wall maximum length, R50 and above (14 m then 3 m setback)
text: C3.4.4 Boundary walls may be built in accordance with Table 3.4c provided: i. boundary walls are located behind the street setback; ii. overshadowing does not exceed the limits of C3.9.1; and iii. they are finished to an equivalent standard to the rest of the development, to the satisfaction of the decision-maker. Table 3.4c Lot boundary setbacks, R50 and above: maximum boundary wall height 7m; maximum boundary wall length 14m length, at which point the wall is to be set back a minimum of 3m measured from the lot boundary for a minimum length of 3m; number of boundaries All; related figure 3.4j.

parts.label: portion beyond 14 m set back 3 m for at least 3 m

exceptions.label: abuts an existing or simultaneously constructed wall of similar or greater dimension (C3.4.5)

replaces.note: 14 m then 3 m setback for a minimum 3 m length

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Applies to every R50+ lot; lots with frontage over 8.5 m must also meet the cumulative 65% test (C3.4.4#length-r50-wide). Overlaps C3.4.2 (14 m two-storey wall rule); unclear whether both apply (register ch3-065).
